title: Zhou2016
description: EEG recordings from four participants performing motor imagery of the left hand, right hand, and feet, originally reported by Zhou et al. (2016) in a study on automated trial selection for motor imagery brain-computer interfaces. Each participant completed three sessions of two runs, giving 450 trials per subject. Data were recorded from 14 channels at 250 Hz and reformatted into BIDS from a MOABB-generated Zenodo version.
methods_description: EEG was recorded from 14 channels placed according to the extended 10/20 system at 250 Hz. Each run had 75 trials (25 per class), with an auditory cue, a 5-second visual arrow cue for motor imagery, and a 4-second rest. Each participant completed three sessions of two runs. MOABB preprocessing extracted the 14 channels, annotated events with 5-second durations, resampled to 250 Hz, and exported to EDF.
